source.title: How To Wear a Bomber Jacket (The Modest Man)

tips.text: A bomber goes with most neutral combinations, from a tee and jeans to a polo, chinos or a button-down.
A slim, minimal bomber over a polo or button-down with chinos or trousers works for smart casual.
tips.why: A close fit keeps smart-casual lines clean.

tips.text: Use a bright bomber as the single colour against an otherwise monochrome outfit, or a neutral one (olive, grey, khaki) to blend in.
tips.why: One colour pop becomes the focal point.

tips.text: Only roomy classic bombers fit a hoodie or flannel layered underneath; slim bombers bunch up.
tips.why: Slim bombers have no room for layers.

tips.text: Classic bombers look best with jeans, chinos or trousers; only sporty ones suit shorts.
tips.why: A classic bomber with shorts looks unbalanced.

tips.text: A black bomber works wherever a leather jacket would: with denim and boots or sneakers.
tips.why: It shares the moto jacket's edge.

tips.text: With an athleisure bomber, wear structured pieces like a henley and tapered joggers, not baggy sweats and oversized tees.
tips.why: Clean lines keep sporty looks sharp.

outfits.outfit: jacket black casual +bomber, tshirt white casual, jeans denim casual, sneakers white casual
outfits.why: A classic casual base with an easy outer layer.

outfits.outfit: jacket brown casual +bomber +suede, tshirt white casual, jeans denim casual, boots brown casual
jacket navy slim minimal +bomber, polo white smart casual, trousers beige smart casual +chinos, sneakers white minimal
outfits.why: A polo and chinos with a close-fitting bomber.

outfits.outfit: jacket black slim minimal +bomber, shirt light blue smart +button-down, trousers grey smart +wool, dress-shoes brown smart +loafers
outfits.why: A minimal bomber over polished trousers.

outfits.outfit: jacket navy sporty +bomber, tshirt grey casual +henley, shorts beige casual, sneakers white casual
outfits.why: A sporty bomber keeps shorts looking intentional.

outfits.outfit: jacket olive vintage +bomber +nylon, shirt olive outdoor +utility, trousers beige outdoor +chinos, boots brown outdoor
jacket red minimal +bomber, sweater cream luxury +cashmere, trousers cream minimal +chinos, sneakers white minimal
outfits.why: A tonal base lets a bright bomber pop.

outfits.outfit: jacket olive casual +bomber, shirt grey casual, trousers beige casual, dress-shoes brown casual +loafers
outfits.why: Subtle contrasts let the bomber blend in.

outfits.outfit: jacket black sporty +bomber, tshirt white oversized sporty, joggers grey baggy sporty, sneakers white sporty
outfits.why: Baggy sweats and an oversized tee fight a structured sporty bomber.
